system.description: Action + up to (SL × 5) MP; each 5 MP buys one option, once each: inflict slow; cure slow; a slowed enemy loses (10 + SL × 5) HP; a creature takes a free Equipment action; an ally yet to act takes their turn after yours. Variant available: Second Slicer — free attack, +(SL) Accuracy, inflicts slow with riders. Chosen permanently.
